## Setup
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(rprojroot)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(SeuratObject)
library(scCustomize)
library(AUCell)
library(msigdbr)
library(pheatmap)
library(cowplot)

# Define directories
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "v4")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "murine-cart-tumor")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")

# Source custom theme
source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))

# set random seed
set.seed(1234)
```

## Load Data
```{r load-data}
# Load Seurat object
myeloid_obj <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "cart_myeloid_subtypes.rds"))

# Standardize subtype naming
myeloid_obj$myeloid_subtype <- myeloid_obj$myeloid_subtype %>%
  stringr::str_replace(
    "Perivascular macrophages.*",
    "Perivascular macrophages"
  )

unique(myeloid_obj$myeloid_subtype)
```

## Visualize top markers per subcluster by dot plot
```{r visualize-subcluster-markers-dotplot, fig.height=16, fig.width=8, warning=FALSE}
myeloid_subcluster_markers <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "myeloid_subcluster_markers.csv"))

myeloid_subcluster_markers <- myeloid_subcluster_markers %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05)

top10_markers <- myeloid_subcluster_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)

hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "H")

category_df <- top10_markers %>%
  inner_join(
    hallmark %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol),
    by = c("gene" = "gene_symbol")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(category = gs_name)

category_df_clean <- category_df %>%
  distinct(gene, category, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---- Remove unwanted Hallmark categories ----
categories_to_remove <- c(
  "HALLMARK_ADIPOGENESIS",
  "HALLMARK_ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION",
  "HALLMARK_ANDROGEN_RESPONSE",
  "HALLMARK_APICAL_JUNCTION",
  "HALLMARK_CHOLESTEROL_HOMEOSTASIS",
  "HALLMARK_COAGULATION",
  "HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION"
)

category_df_clean <- category_df_clean %>%
  filter(!category %in% categories_to_remove)

category_df_clean <- category_df_clean %>%
  arrange(category, gene)

# remove categories that have only one gene (don't plot these)
category_counts <- category_df_clean %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  tally(name = "n_genes")

categories_to_keep <- category_counts %>%
  filter(n_genes > 1) %>%
  pull(category)

category_df_clean <- category_df_clean %>%
  filter(category %in% categories_to_keep)

gene_order <- unique(category_df_clean$gene)

anyDuplicated(gene_order)

# ---- safer gene positions per category ----
gene_pos_df <- category_df_clean %>%
  mutate(pos = match(gene, gene_order)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pos))

category_bounds <- gene_pos_df %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarize(
    start = min(pos),
    end   = max(pos),
    mid   = (start + end) / 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Clean category names: remove HALLMARK_ and replace "_" with space
category_labels <- category_bounds %>%
  mutate(category_clean = category %>%
           str_remove("HALLMARK_") %>%
           str_replace_all("_", "\n"))

# ---- main dotplot (remove manual bottom margin hack) ----
p_main <- DotPlot(
  myeloid_obj,
  features = gene_order,
  cols = "RdYlBu",
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",
  assay = "RNA"
) +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "plain"),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "plain"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  ylab("Cluster") +
  geom_vline(
    data = category_bounds,
    aes(xintercept = end + 0.5),
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "black",
    size = 0.4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )

# ---- bottom strip: ONLY category labels, aligned to gene positions ----
p_cat <- ggplot(category_labels, aes(x = mid, y = 0, label = category_clean)) +
  geom_text(
    angle = 0,
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 4,
    #fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 1.0
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(1, length(gene_order)),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.30, 0.05),
    expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 25, l = 10)
  )

# ---- stack them: categories UNDER gene labels ----
p_final <- p_main / p_cat + 
  plot_layout(heights = c(12, 0.8))

pdf(file = file.path(plot_dir, "myeloid_dotplot_subcluster_markers.pdf"),
    width = 20, height = 8)
print(p_final)
dev.off()

```

## Visualize subcluster dot plot using manual gene list from panel E
```{r visualize-subcluster-markers-panelE-dotplot, fig.height=12, fig.width=8, warning=FALSE}
panelE_categories <- list(
  "Lineage" = c("Adgre1", "Itgam", "Itgax", "Itga4", "Aif1"),
  "Pro-tumorigenic (M1)" = c(
    "Trem1", "Arg1", "Mrc1", "Il4ra", "Chil3", "Ccl6", "Fn1", "Il13ra1", "Ccl24",
    "Stat3", "Egr2", "Hif1a", "Socs2", "Msr1", "Top2a", "Sparc", "Birc5", "Gpnmb", "Cxcl10"
  ),
  "Anti-tumorigenic (M2)" = c(
    "Lyz2", "Il18bp", "Ms4a7", "Thbs1", "Pf4", "Stat1", "Ifi27", "Apoc2", "Il1b",
    "Il1a", "Ifngr2", "Cxcl9", "H2-Eb1", "H2-Ab1"
  ),
  "Differentiation" = c("Cd3g", "Cd3d", "Cd4", "Cd8a")
)

panelE_df <- tibble(
  category = rep(names(panelE_categories), lengths(panelE_categories)),
  gene = unlist(panelE_categories)
)

gene_order_E <- unname(panelE_df$gene)

category_bounds_E <- panelE_df %>%
  mutate(pos = match(gene, gene_order_E)) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    start = min(pos),
    end   = max(pos),
    mid   = (start + end) / 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(start)

category_vlines_E <- category_bounds_E %>%
  mutate(xintercept = end + 0.5)

p_main_E <- DotPlot(
  myeloid_obj,
  features = gene_order_E,
  cols = "RdYlBu",
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",
  assay = "RNA"
) +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "plain"),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "plain"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  ylab("Cluster") +
  geom_vline(
    data = category_vlines_E,
    aes(xintercept = xintercept),
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "black",
    size = 0.4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )

p_cat_E <- ggplot(category_bounds_E, aes(x = mid, y = 0, label = category)) +
  geom_text(
    angle = 0,
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 5,
    #fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 1
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(1, length(gene_order_E)),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.25, 0.05),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 25, l = 10)
  )

p_final_E <- p_main_E / p_cat_E +
  plot_layout(heights = c(12, 0.6))

pdf(file = file.path(plot_dir, "myeloid_dotplot_subcluster_markers_panelE.pdf"),
    width = 15, height = 5)
print(p_final_E)
dev.off()
```

## Visualize top markers per subtype by dot plot
```{r visualize-subtype-markers-dotplot, fig.height=16, fig.width=8, warning=FALSE}
myeloid_subtype_markers <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "myeloid_subtype_markers.csv"))

myeloid_subtype_markers <- myeloid_subtype_markers %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05)

top10_markers <- myeloid_subtype_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)

category_df <- top10_markers %>%
  inner_join(
    hallmark %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol),
    by = c("gene" = "gene_symbol")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(category = gs_name)

category_df_clean <- category_df %>%
  distinct(gene, category, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Remove unwanted categories
categories_to_remove <- c(
  "HALLMARK_ADIPOGENESIS",
  "HALLMARK_ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION",
  "HALLMARK_ANDROGEN_RESPONSE",
  "HALLMARK_APICAL_JUNCTION",
  "HALLMARK_CHOLESTEROL_HOMEOSTASIS",
  "HALLMARK_COAGULATION",
  "HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION"
)

category_df_clean <- category_df_clean %>%
  filter(!category %in% categories_to_remove)

category_df_clean <- category_df_clean %>%
  arrange(category, gene)

# remove categories that have only one gene (don't plot these)
category_counts <- category_df_clean %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  tally(name = "n_genes")

categories_to_keep <- category_counts %>%
  filter(n_genes > 1) %>%
  pull(category)

category_df_clean <- category_df_clean %>%
  filter(category %in% categories_to_keep)

gene_order <- unique(category_df_clean$gene)

# Category positions
gene_pos_df <- category_df_clean %>%
  mutate(pos = match(gene, gene_order)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pos))

category_bounds <- gene_pos_df %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarize(
    start = min(pos),
    end   = max(pos),
    mid   = (start + end) / 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create category labels dataframe
category_labels <- category_bounds %>%
  mutate(
    category_clean = category %>%
      str_remove("HALLMARK_") %>%
      str_replace_all("_", "\n")
  )

# Reusable plotting function
make_dotplot <- function(obj, exclude_subtypes = NULL, file_name) {
  
  obj_plot <- obj
  
  if (!is.null(exclude_subtypes)) {
    obj_plot <- subset(
      obj_plot,
      subset = !myeloid_subtype %in% exclude_subtypes
    )
  }
  
  p_main <- DotPlot(
    obj_plot,
    features = gene_order,
    cols = "RdYlBu",
    group.by = "myeloid_subtype",
    assay = "RNA"
  ) +
    theme_Publication() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "plain"),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "plain"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    ylab(NULL) +
    geom_vline(
      data = category_bounds,
      aes(xintercept = end + 0.5),
      linetype = "dotted",
      color = "black",
      size = 0.4,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
  
  p_cat <- ggplot(category_labels, aes(x = mid, y = 0, label = category_clean)) +
    geom_text(
      angle = 0,
      hjust = 0.5,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4,
      #fontface = "bold",
      lineheight = 1
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(1, length(gene_order)),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(-0.30, 0.05),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 25, l = 10))
  
  p_final <- p_main / p_cat +
    plot_layout(heights = c(12, 0.8))
  
  pdf(file = file.path(plot_dir, file_name),
      width = 20, height = 8)
  print(p_final)
  dev.off()
}

# Exclude Inflammatory monocytes
make_dotplot(
  myeloid_obj,
  exclude_subtypes = c("Inflammatory monocytes"),
  file_name = "myeloid_dotplot_subtype_markers_exclude_inflammatory_monocytes.pdf"
)
```

## Marker genes on treatment groups
```{r subset-treatment-markers, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
myeloid_treatment_markers <- FindAllMarkers(myeloid_obj,
                                            assay = "RNA",
                                            group.by = "condition",
                                            slot = "data",
                                            only.pos = TRUE,
                                            min.pct = 0.5,
                                            logfc.threshold = 0.5)

myeloid_treatment_markers <- myeloid_treatment_markers %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05)

write.csv(myeloid_treatment_markers, file.path(results_dir, "myeloid_treatment_markers.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Visualize top markers per treatment by dot plot
```{r visualize-treatment-markers-dotplot, fig.height=16, fig.width=8, warning=FALSE}
myeloid_treatment_markers <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "myeloid_treatment_markers.csv"))

category_df <- myeloid_treatment_markers %>%
  inner_join(
    hallmark %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol),
    by = c("gene" = "gene_symbol")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(category = gs_name)

category_df_clean <- category_df %>%
  distinct(gene, category, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%   
  group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Remove unwanted categories
categories_to_remove <- c(
  "HALLMARK_ADIPOGENESIS",
  "HALLMARK_ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION",
  "HALLMARK_ANDROGEN_RESPONSE",
  "HALLMARK_APICAL_JUNCTION"
)

category_df_clean <- category_df_clean %>%
  filter(!category %in% categories_to_remove)

category_df_clean <- category_df_clean %>%
  arrange(category, gene)

# Remove categories with only 1 gene
category_df_clean <- category_df_clean %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()

gene_order <- unique(category_df_clean$gene)

# Category positions
gene_pos_df <- category_df_clean %>%
  mutate(pos = match(gene, gene_order)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pos))

category_bounds <- gene_pos_df %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarize(
    start = min(pos),
    end   = max(pos),
    mid   = (start + end) / 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Clean category labels
category_labels <- category_bounds %>%
  mutate(
    category_clean = category %>%
      str_remove("HALLMARK_") %>%
      str_replace_all("_", "\n")
  )

# main dotplot
p_main <- DotPlot(
  myeloid_obj,
  features = gene_order,
  cols = "RdYlBu",
  group.by = "condition",
  assay = "RNA"
) +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "plain"),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "plain"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    size = "Percent Expressed",
    color = "Average Expression"
  ) +
  guides(
    size = guide_legend(order = 1),
    color = guide_colorbar(order = 2)
  ) +
  ylab(NULL) +
  geom_vline(
    data = category_bounds,
    aes(xintercept = end + 0.5),
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "black",
    size = 0.4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )

# Category Strip (clean + compact)
p_cat <- ggplot(category_labels, aes(x = mid, y = 0, label = category_clean)) +
  geom_text(
    angle = 0,
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 4,
    #fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 1.0
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(1, length(gene_order)),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.30, 0.05),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 25, l = 10)
  )

# Combine
p_final <- p_main / p_cat +
  plot_layout(heights = c(12, 1.5))

pdf(file = file.path(plot_dir, "myeloid_dotplot_treatment_markers.pdf"),
    width = 15, height = 5)
print(p_final)
dev.off()
```
